requirements.text: Customers should be able to book appointments anytime through a digital platform.
Reminders should be sent 24 hours and 1 hour before appointments, including details such as date, time, barber's name, and service booked.
Barbers should manage their schedules directly, including setting working hours, breaks, and blocking off days.
The system should provide daily and weekly summaries with total bookings, cancellations, no-shows, insights into peak times, and tracking of customer no-show history for flagging.
The system must comply with data protection laws to ensure the secure handling of sensitive customer information.
It should be cost-effective in terms of both initial setup and ongoing operational costs.
The user interface needs to be user-friendly to minimize the learning curve for both staff and customers.
